stem_book: Passage: Consider the following elements with their electronegativity value (Pauling scale): A 3.77, B 1.12, C 2.25, D 3.10. (i) Incorrect statement is: (a) AOH is more acidic than DOH (b) BOH is more basic than COH (c) 'AB' molecule is predominantly ionic (d) 'D—OH' bond is more weaker than 'B—OH' bond in polar solvent. (ii) Select correct statement: (a) Oxide of element D is more acidic than that of A (b) Oxides of elements C and D are basic in nature (c) Oxide of element B is acidic in nature (d) BOH is more basic than H₂O
reason: Two-part passage with separate answers (both key entries verified).
work: (i) B (EN 1.12) gives ionic B—OH that ionises in polar solvent, so D—OH is the stronger bond ⇒ (d) false; (ii) only BOH (low-EN metal hydroxide) more basic than H₂O is true
